jobs.name: build
jobs.title: Build
jobs.description: Cleans and recompiles dist/; every job that reads or rewrites dist/ shares this lane so none races it.

public.title: Bump the version and draft the notes on rc-{version}, made from develop
Reconcile master into rc-{version} when they diverged (merge -s ours; nothing to do otherwise)
Write the [{version}] section of docs/changelog.md
public.manual: In the release worktree (../SaaSFoundry-release, on rc-{version}), in docs/changelog.md, move the entries of '## [Unreleased]' under a new '## [{version}] - YYYY-MM-DD' heading (today's date) placed right below '## [Unreleased]', which stays empty. Keep the heading exactly in that form: publish-stable.yml runs scripts/release-notes.mjs {version}, which refuses a missing or empty section and builds the GitHub Release notes from it.

public.title: Write the [{version}] section of docs/fr/changelog.md
public.manual: In the release worktree (../SaaSFoundry-release, on rc-{version}), in docs/fr/changelog.md, move the entries of '## [Non publié]' under a new '## [{version}] - YYYY-MM-DD' heading placed right below '## [Non publié]', which stays empty: the French translation of the English section, same date.

public.title: Set the current version line of AGENTS.md to {version}
public.manual: In the release worktree (../SaaSFoundry-release, on rc-{version}), in AGENTS.md (Important Context), set the line to '- Current version: {version} (npm package `saasfoundryai-cli`)'. It still reads 1.0.0-beta, so it is not a version file the bump can read back; the cut commits it with the changelogs.

public.title: Rewrite the public notes with the coding agent
Commit the release on rc-{version} and open its pull request to master
public.confirm: Pushes rc-{version} with the release commit of {tag} and opens its pull request to master.

public.title: Merge the pull request into master with a merge commit once CI / Required gate is green
public.confirm: Merges the pull request of {tag} into master with a merge commit (never squash or rebase: v1.0.1's rebase merge made master and develop diverge) once CI / Required gate is green.

public.title: Tag the merge commit and push the tag: publish-stable.yml starts on the tag
public.confirm: {tag} is public once pushed: publish-stable.yml waits for the tag's Tests run, then the environment npm-production asks for an approval on GitHub before npm publish and the GitHub Release.

public.title: Close the milestone once the release is published
Merge master back into develop with a merge commit
public.confirm: Opens the pull request of master (at {tag}) into develop and merges it with a merge commit once its checks are green, never squash or rebase: master must become part of develop's history, or the branches diverge again.
